notes.title: First Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31851932/1446ce045f27744574578cd9b2093749e330df24.jpg[/img]

Announcing our first big update, which we could call ... the [b]Vicars Update![/b] It coincides with the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b] where for but a fleeting moment you may purchase Basingstoke with a [b]34% discount![/b]

[h1]New Environments[/h1]

Find refuge in the [b]Church[/b], discover the secrets of the [b]Catacombs[/b], and escape from the [b]Cemetery[/b].

[h1]New Player Class and Special Items[/h1]

Reach the Church and unlock the new [b]Vicar class[/b], and get access to unique items and crafting recipes such as [b]The Holy Waterpistol[/b] and the [b]The Holy Hand Grenade[/b].

[h1]New 'Horde' Game Mode[/h1]

[b]Horde Mode[/b] is a completely separate new game mode with [b]local[/b] and [b]online global leaderboards.[/b]

Pick a character with a specific loadout, choose a map, and see how long you can survive against ever-hungrier incursions of Basingtoke's finest citizens. Ammo respawns.


We're continually updating Basingstoke with bug fixes, tweaks, and new content. We've got more environments, character unlocks, items, recipes, monsters, and game modes planned, all for free! We build a new update every night in the "alpha" channel, and promote that to "beta" every two weeks. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Basingstoke Release
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31851932/02ecf06c1d9b7bfca2aad0cd942d0e2e751c7769.png[/img]

[h1]Basingstoke Is Nearly Here[/h1]

Minions! Let is be known that our vicious roguelike survival horror game [b]BASINGSTOKE[/b] is due for release on the SLIGHTLY ADJUSTED DATE of [b]April 27th, 2018 @ 11:00am PST[/b]. Go forth and [url=store.steampowered.com/app/336940/Basingstoke]wishlist it[/url] so you'll get a reminder when it finally appears (with a wee discount).

[h1]Eh? What's Basingstoke?[/h1]

We've spent the last [b]four years[/b] making a game about escaping a mediocre small town in southern England. Set in the near future, Basingstoke has been invaded by the evil Titans, and nearly everyone has been killed by a neutron bomb. [i]Nearly[/i] everyone...

You've got to escape alive through Basingstoke's randomly generated suburban sprawl, looting bodies as you go, crafting new things to help you evade detection, distract your enemies, or just plain old kill them as a last resort. Everything you encounter will kill you instantly, so stealth and planning are the keys to survival. And running away a lot while throwing sausage rolls over your shoulder.

A few more details can be found [url=http://www.puppygames.net/basingstoke]here[/url] on our site.
